findings.evidenceJa: 同じ殺気を放っていた
findings.governingReading: Her eyes project the same 殺気 as their first hostile night meeting.

findings.highlight: She runs away without a second thought.
findings.evidenceJa: 止める間もなく走り去っていく
findings.governingReading: 止める間もなく concerns the lack of time to intervene.
findings.explanation: Leaving before Shirou can stop her becomes leaving without a second thought.

findings.highlight: I should've apologized to Illya, no doubt about it.
findings.evidenceJa: もっと考えてイリヤに謝るべきだった
findings.governingReading: もっと考えて modifies how he should have apologized; he already apologized and bowed on page1.
findings.explanation: Regretting an insufficiently considered apology becomes regretting not apologizing.
